trickyParts: ygo's OnTokenAuth gets only (room, token), so the HTTP-time admission is recorded per (room, schema_version) and answered to the token; the 15 s re-check closes a revoked socket with 1012 through a wrapped hijacked conn.

A take-over writes its computed start into the hold token before deleting the durable; a graceful stop with that start pending lapses the hold rather than deleting its row, so the next holder finds the start.
The editor gate runs only on editable parses: the collab sync, read-only setMarkdown and the version view read every element.
The previous release exits without acking the message in its handler; the harness tolerates exactly that one redelivery.
deviations: A page that sends no schema_creatable counts R = 1 (review round 1), so a newer page after a rollback is read-only while older pages stay writable.
